embeds.title: BLHA GM LOUNGE
embeds.description: The clubhouse. This is where general managers talk hockey, discuss league business and enjoy the league.

fields.name: USE THIS ROOM FOR
fields.value: League talk • Proposal discussion before a vote • Hockey conversation • Getting to know your fellow owners

fields.name: OTHER ROOMS
fields.value: **game-day** for live games • **chirps-and-memes** for trash talk • **off-topic** for everything else • **media** for clips and photos

fields.name: NOT FOR OFFICIAL BUSINESS
fields.value: Votes, rulings, trades and deadlines belong in their own rooms. Nothing said in the lounge changes a rule or a result.
